[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |role =Vault dweller |TV actor =[[Jeremy Levick]] }} '''Pete''' is a resident of [[Vault 31]] who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== A [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] employee and one of the cryogenically frozen residents of [[Vault 31]], Pete is a participant in the "[[Bud's Buds]]" program, created by [[Bud Askins]].
